name: Job Shadowing Program
what_you_do: Follow a health care worker at Denver Health to see a normal workday. You learn the skills and school needed for that job.
who_can_apply: Students ages 14 or older. You must be in high school or in a college undergraduate program.
deadline_text: The application was closed after July 31, 2026. The page says it is expected to reopen in early November 2026 for winter break shadowing.
how_to_apply: Apply online when the application reopens. All required documents must be in by the deadline.
notes: Denver Health is at 777 Bannock Street, Denver. Students who cannot shadow can look at the MC2 internship (rising juniors).
